neighbours.label: After 'and' (or French 'et'), the quantifier or determiner that opens a second parallel partitive phrase (and one of, and half of them, and those who, et les petits): the start of the mirrored second half of a coordination
fire: The cathedral is one of the largest in Spain and one of the least visited.
Two thirds of the voters backed the measure and one third of them opposed it.
Some of the guests arrived by train and some of them by car.
The novel is both one of his shortest works and one of his darkest.
Half of the fields were planted with wheat and half of them left fallow.
There were those who wanted to fight and those who wanted to flee.
Most of the crew slept below deck and a few of them kept watch.
Les riches seraient épargnés et les pauvres paieraient la facture.
quiet: The cathedral is one of the largest in Spain, though few tourists visit it.
Two thirds of the voters backed the measure while the rest opposed it.
Some of the guests arrived by train, the others by car.
The novel is one of his shortest works, but it is also very dark.
Half of the fields were planted with wheat and left to ripen.
Those who wanted to fight were outnumbered by the ones who wanted to flee.
Most of the crew slept below deck while the officers kept watch.
Les riches seraient épargnés, mais pas les pauvres.

predictions: Coordinations whose second half repeats a partitive opener (and one of, and half of, and some of, and those who, et les) peak on that opener at 0.1-0.3; the same sentences with the second half rephrased (while the rest, with a beautiful square) stay under 0.1. A low-amplitude broad pole (card max 4.4, 1.1% of tokens above a tenth of max), so a median above 0.3 is unlikely.
notes: Probe: 'and half of them' 0.229, 'and one of the most' 0.166, 'et les petits' 0.162, 'those who ... and those who' 0.130; controls 'with a beautiful old square' 0.106 (' old'), 'while the others' 0.054, 'came early' 0.042, 'sang and danced' 0.036, floor 0.038. Card: ' one' x6, ' half', ' those', ' les', ' des' after and/et (max 4.38, layer 3, broad flag, gate-closed 98%). Direction right, amplitude small.
